# Hosting / cloud address blocks: a visit from here is a server, not a buyer.
# Used by ve_score.py's bot filter ("discard data-centre IPs", docs/validation_engine.md).
# Broad aggregates of the big providers only; a block that also carries home users (VPN,
# mobile carriers, Cloudflare WARP) is deliberately left out: discarding a real buyer is
# worse than keeping a stray bot, which the other filters (under 2 s, bot user agent,
# webdriver) still catch. Add a provider's own published list with --extra-cidrs.
